Name: Pokeball Digspots
Author: notacrowscorpse
Description:
My first ever mod!

I'm working on adding some more customization options, like adding Animations(and all of the other Pokéballs). I'm currently working on Safari, Net, Dive and Nest Balls, and the animations i plan on doing are Rolling, Shine, Sparkle and Bounce. All of what i just listed is a [b]Work in Progress[/b], do not expect them at the present time.

In order to customize you can either go into the mod file and edit the one named 'Config', or install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GCMC[/url] to customize it in game. To use this make sure you have content patcher, then just download, unzip it and drop into your mods folder with all your other CP mods :D

Downloads.Description: Added art for Great Balls and Master Balls, And added configuration options(to choose which Dig Spot is which Pokéball).
